Name: Ferngill Republic Ministry of Agriculture
Author: Darkskyid
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]

The Ferngill Republic Ministry of Agriculture intervenes in agricultural markets each season, adjusting the selling prices of 2 or 4 crops based on events. Each price change comes with an official mail bulletin explaining the "official" reason for the market adjustment through government announcements.

Price changes only occur on [b]Day 1[/b] of each new season (Spring, Summer, Fall). If you're already past Day 1, use the SMAPI console command
[code]ferngill_test[/code]to manually trigger price changes and bulletins.
[line]
[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]

[b]Dynamic Price Fluctuations[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Seasonal Changes:[/b] Each season (Spring, Summer, Fall), 2 or 4 crops have their selling prices modified[/*]
[*][b]Price Range:[/b] Modifiers range from -30% to +40% by default, customizable via config[/*]
[*][b]Tier-Based Logic:[/b] Higher value crops are more likely to decrease in price, while cheaper crops are more likely to increase[/*]
[*][b]Winter Dormancy:[/b] No price changes during winter, with a special bulletin explaining market inactivity[/*]
[*][b]Mod Compatibility:[/b] Works with crop adding mods, new crops are automatically tiered based on their vanilla harvest prices[/*]
[/list][b]Government Bulletin System[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Immersive Mail:[/b] Receive official bulletins explaining the "government reasons" for price changes[/*]
[*][b]Immersive Narratives:[/b] Over 40 narrative templates covering various ministries and scenarios; 
[code]Have an idea for a bulletin? Drop it in the comments![/code][/*]
[/list][b]Smart Crop Selection[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Season Aware:[/b] Only selects crops that grow in the current season[/*]
[*][b]Tier System:[/b] Crops are categorized into S, A, B, C tiers based on their vanilla prices[/*]
[*][b]Weighted Selection:[/b] Higher tier crops more likely to be selected for price decreases[/*]
[*][b]Configurable Targets:[/b] Choose between 2 or 4 crops affected per season[/*]
[*][b]Mod Compatibility:[/b] Crops added by other mods are automatically detected and tiered based on their harvest price[/*]
[/list][b]Persistent System[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Save Compatibility:[/b] Modifiers persist through saves and game sessions[/*]
[*][b]Seasonal reset[/b]: Prices reset at the start of each new season (Spring, Summer, Fall) [/*]
[*][b]Clean Mail Management:[/b] Automatically removes old bulletins when new ones arrive[/*]
[*][b]Seasonal Timing:[/b] Price changes only occur on Day 1 of each season, use
[code]ferngill_test[/code]command if you need to trigger changes mid-season[/*]
[/list][line]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[b]Required[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] 4.0.0+[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[/list]
[b]Optional[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] For ingame configuration
Not required for mod functionality, If not installed configure via
[code]config.json[/code]in the mod folder[/*]
[/list][line]
[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*][b]Required:[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI (Stardew Modding API)[/url] version 4.0.0 or higher[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 or higher[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]Download the latest release from the mod page[/*]
[*]Extract the
[code]FerngillMinistry[/code]folder to your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]directory[/*]
[*]The folder structure should be:
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods/FerngillMinistry/[/code][/*]
[*]Launch the game using SMAPI[/*]
[*][b]Optional (Recommended):[/b]
[list]
[*] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for ingame configuration[/*]
[*]With GMCM installed, configure the mod from the games title screen or ingame menu[/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list][line]
[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]

The mod is highly configurable through
[code]config.json[/code]or via Generic Mod Config Menu:

[b]Price Settings[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Min Change %:[/b] Minimum price change percentage (default: -30%)[/*]
[*][b]Max Change %:[/b] Maximum price change percentage (default: +40%)[/*]
[*][b]Price Floor:[/b] Absolute minimum multiplier (default: 0.5x / half price)[/*]
[*][b]Price Ceiling:[/b] Absolute maximum multiplier (default: 2.0x / double price)[/*]
[/list][b]Target Selection[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Number of Targets:[/b] How many crops are affected each season (2 or 4)[/*]
[*][b]Crops Only:[/b] If enabled, excludes flowers from price changes[/*]
[*][b]Exclude Starter Crops:[/b] If enabled, excludes basic crops like Parsnip[/*]
[/list][b]Mail Settings[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Enable Mail:[/b] Toggle whether to receive seasonal bulletins[/*]
[/list][b]Console Commands[/b]
[list]
[*][code]ferngill_test[/code]- Trigger a test bulletin for specified season[/*]
[*][code]ferngill_clear[/code]- Clear all active price modifiers[/*]
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Fixed: crops could rarely roll 0% price change. Every selected crop now actually goes up or down.
